en.headline: Chan opens three-day LegCo debate on the five-year plan
en.dek: The Chief Secretary moved the motion on the 2026-2030 plan and said success depends on putting it into practice, with the Policy Address as the yearly programme.
body: Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki on Wednesday moved the motion on Hong Kong's first five-year plan for economic and social development, covering 2026 to 2030. The Legislative Council is holding a combined debate with the motion of thanks on the 2026 Policy Address over three days, after the president accepted the government's request to merge the two.

Chan told the council the plan was published with the Policy Address on 16 September. He said it is meant to set a direction for the next five years, using the city's links to the mainland and to the rest of the world, with economic development and better livelihoods as the two goals. The six areas he listed are strengthening the four centres and a talent hub, consolidating international advantages, speeding up the Northern Metropolis, deepening the Greater Bay Area and a global cooperation network, improving livelihoods, and coordinating development and security.

He said the government had run a two-month consultation with more than 100 sessions, more than 30 of them chaired by the Chief Executive, and received more than 17,000 submissions, eight in ten from individual residents. Implementation, he said, would run through the five-year plan, annual Policy Address measures, Budget support and the Chief Executive's yearly report to the central government. This year's address sets five development opportunities and measures across 25 livelihood areas, including youth employment, births, elderly care, carers, primary healthcare and labour protection. Chan said he would lead the upgraded committee on the university town, and that the Hetao research building due by year-end would be its flagship start.

zh.headline: 陳國基動議五年規劃議案 立法會展開三日合併辯論
zh.dek: 政務司司長周三動議2026至2030年經濟和社會發展第一個五年規劃議案，並指規劃落到實處才是成功關鍵。
body: 政務司司長陳國基周三在立法會動議通過《香港特別行政區經濟和社會發展第一個五年規劃（2026—2030年）》議案。立法會主席接納政府建議，把五年規劃議案與《行政長官2026年施政報告》致謝議案合併辯論，一連三日進行。
陳國基說，規劃上月16日與施政報告一併公布，目的是為未來五年訂出方向和路徑，發揮背靠國家、聯通世界的優勢，服務發展經濟和改善民生兩個目標。他列出六大範疇：強化四大中心和人才集聚高地、鞏固國際競爭優勢、加快北部都會區建設、深化粵港澳大灣區並搭建全球合作網絡、提升民生福祉，以及統籌發展和安全。

他說，政府曾展開兩個月公眾諮詢，舉辦超過100場諮詢會，其中行政長官主持超過30場，並收到超過17,000份意見書，八成來自個別市民。落實框架是五年規劃統領、年度施政落實、財政預算支持和年度述職匯報。今年施政報告提出五大發展機遇，並在25個民生範疇提出措施，包括青年就業、鼓勵生育、安老、照顧者、基層醫療和勞工保障。陳國基說，他會領導升格後的大學城建設及發展委員會，年底前落成的河套學研壹號大樓將是大學城的起動項目。
